t: You're at Ben Jonson House, a mid-rise terrace block on the Barbican Estate. It is named after Ben Jonson, the English playwright, poet and actor, who lived from 1572 to 1637. He is regarded as the second most important English dramatist after Shakespeare during the reign of James the First. His best-known plays include Volpone, The Alchemist and Bartholomew Fair, and his lyric poetry has had a lasting influence.
